from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from azure.storage.blob import generate_blob_sas, BlobSasPermissions
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from django.conf import settings
from .models import ResearchProject

class ProjectDatasetUploadSASView(APIView):

    def post(self, request, project_uuid):

        blob_name = f"projects/{project.uuid}/datasets/{request.data.get('filename')}"

        sas_token = generate_blob_sas(
            account_name=settings.AZURE_ACCOUNT_NAME,
            container_name="research-data",
            blob_name=blob_name,
            account_key=settings.AZURE_ACCOUNT_KEY,
            permission=BlobSasPermissions(write=True, create=True),
            expiry=datetime.utcnow() + timedelta(minutes=30)

        sas_url = f"https://{settings.AZURE_ACCOUNT_NAME}.blob.core.windows.net/research-data/{blob_name}?{sas_token}"

diagnosis: The endpoint issues an Azure Blob write SAS token for a project located by project_uuid, but fails to check whether request.user belongs to the research project or its governing lab. Any authenticated user can upload corrupted or unauthorized data into other research teams' private project containers.

corrected_code:
from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from azure.storage.blob import generate_blob_sas, BlobSasPermissions
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from django.conf import settings
from .models import ResearchProject

class ProjectDatasetUploadSASView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request, project_uuid):
        project = get_object_or_404(ResearchProject, uuid=project_uuid, collaborators=request.user)
        blob_name = f"projects/{project.uuid}/datasets/{request.data.get('filename')}"

        sas_token = generate_blob_sas(
            account_name=settings.AZURE_ACCOUNT_NAME,
            container_name="research-data",
            blob_name=blob_name,
            account_key=settings.AZURE_ACCOUNT_KEY,
            permission=BlobSasPermissions(write=True, create=True),
            expiry=datetime.utcnow() + timedelta(minutes=30)
        )
        sas_url = f"https://{settings.AZURE_ACCOUNT_NAME}.blob.core.windows.net/research-data/{blob_name}?{sas_token}"
        return Response({"sas_url": sas_url, "blob_name": blob_name})
